snaps.body:
Existing ERP moduleExisting Invoice & Payment module. Runs the three-way match (PO ↔ GRN ↔ invoice), payment authorisation and closure.
This module sends
PO commitments and LC / advance terms
It sends back
Payment reference, reconciled supplier balance, PO closure
Hand-off queue4 PO(s) become payable commitments
